Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision that occurred while the patient was turning left and was struck from the side.
Complaints centered on the right knee, including pain, swelling, and difficulty bearing weight. Over six visits, care
consisted of physical examination, imaging review, guided rehabilitation exercises, and activity modification. The
mechanism of injury described is consistent with the knee findings observed at presentation. Some examination
findings, including localized tenderness and reduced range of motion, support the reported injury, while ligament
stability testing and neurovascular checks were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the same knee has
been identified in the history. The course of recovery was somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of
injury, and progress was gradual but steady. Billing entries for two similar services on the same day are under rouitne
review to confirm accuracy and avoid duplication. Ongoing follow-up is recommended, with return precautions
reviewed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
